title: Configure Barcode Interface scanner settings (password, prefixes, HTTP/OPC URLs) for AGV and Hospital control IPs
summary: On the Windows laptop used for scanner setup, update the replacement Zebra DS3608-SR scanner’s Barcode Interface settings so tote/location label prefixes match and the HTTP/OPC URLs point to the correct AGV control and Hospital control IP addresses, then save the settings.
when_to_use: Use when a scanner is replaced and the new scanner must be set up so Barcode Interface settings use the correct tote/location prefixes and the correct AGV/Hospital control IP addresses in the HTTP and OPC URL fields.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Perform the Barcode Interface settings update (enter password, verify prefixes, update HTTP/OPC URLs, save settings).

access_required: FORTNA account login on the Windows laptop
system_preconditions: Network connectivity from the laptop to both the AGV control and Hospital control (validated by ping per scanner setup requirements).
Barcode Interface application is installed on the Windows laptop (found on the desktop with a FORTNA logo).

visual_references.description: Scanner Setup screen showing the settings button/password prompt, prefix fields, HTTP URL field (AGV control IP), OPC URL field (Hospital control IP), and Save Settings button.

steps.title: Launch Barcode Interface on the scanner setup laptop
steps.purpose: Open the application used to configure the replacement scanner settings.
steps.instruction: On the Windows laptop used for scanner setup, launch the Barcode Interface application (Barcode Interface.exe).
steps.expected_result: Barcode Interface is open and ready for interaction (scanner setup workflow visible).
steps.healthy_condition: The application is running and you can proceed to the settings area.
steps.failure_condition: Barcode Interface does not launch or is not accessible on the desktop.

actions.label: Open Barcode Interface
actions.exact_action: Launch the Barcode Interface application. This should be on the desktop.

steps.title: Open Settings and enter the default password
steps.purpose: Access the protected settings panel to edit prefixes and HTTP/OPC URLs.
steps.instruction: In Barcode Interface, click the "settings" button and supply the default password "Opti".
steps.expected_result: The settings panel accepts the password and the settings fields are available for editing.
steps.healthy_condition: You can view/edit the prefix configuration fields and the HTTP/OPC URL fields.
steps.failure_condition: Password is rejected or settings fields do not become available.

actions.label: Open settings
actions.exact_action: Check the settings by clicking the settings button, supply the password. By default, the pass- word is “Opti”.

steps.title: Verify tote/location label prefixes match
steps.purpose: Ensure the scanner will interpret labels correctly for totes and locations.
steps.instruction: Verify the configured prefixes match the labels on the totes and locations.
steps.expected_result: Prefix values shown in the settings match the tote/location label prefixes you physically verify.
steps.healthy_condition: Prefixes match the tote/location labels (no mismatch observed).
steps.failure_condition: Prefixes do not match the tote/location labels.

actions.label: Compare prefixes
actions.exact_action: Verify prefixes match the labels on the totes and locations.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the prefixes do not match the tote/location labels.

steps.title: Update HTTP and OPC URLs to correct AGV/Hospital control IPs
steps.purpose: Point the scanner interface to the correct AGV control and Hospital control endpoints.
steps.instruction: Change the URL for both the HTTP and OPC settings so the HTTP URL contains the AGV control IP address and the OPC URL contains the Hospital control IP address.
steps.expected_result: HTTP URL field includes the AGV control IP address; OPC URL field includes the Hospital control IP address.
steps.healthy_condition: Both URL fields contain the correct IP addresses in the expected HTTP vs OPC fields.
steps.failure_condition: HTTP/OPC URLs cannot be updated to include the correct AGV control and Hospital control IP addresses.

actions.label: Edit HTTP/OPC URLs
actions.exact_action: Change the URL for both the HTTP and OPC setting to contain the AGV control and Hospital control IP addresses respectively.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the HTTP/OPC URLs cannot be updated to include the correct AGV control and Hospital control IP addresses.

steps.title: Save the scanner settings
steps.purpose: Commit the updated prefixes and URLs so the scanner uses them.
steps.instruction: Save the settings using the "Save Settings" button.
steps.expected_result: Settings are saved (the updated prefix/URL values are committed after clicking "Save Settings").
steps.healthy_condition: After saving, the settings reflect the updated prefixes and the HTTP/OPC URLs with the correct IP addresses.
steps.failure_condition: Settings do not save or the displayed values revert/are not updated after saving.

actions.label: Save settings
actions.exact_action: Save the settings with the "Save Settings" button.

success_criteria: After saving, the Barcode Interface settings reflect prefixes matching tote/location labels.
After saving, the HTTP URL contains the AGV control IP address and the OPC URL contains the Hospital control IP address.
healthy_conditions: HTTP URL field contains AGV control IP address.
OPC URL field contains Hospital control IP address.
Settings are saved via the "Save Settings" button.
failure_conditions: Prefixes do not match tote/location labels.
HTTP/OPC URLs cannot be updated to include the correct AGV control and Hospital control IP addresses.
Settings do not persist after clicking "Save Settings".
escalation_guidance: If prefixes do not match tote/location labels, stop and escalate.
If HTTP/OPC URLs cannot be updated to include the correct AGV control and Hospital control IP addresses, stop and escalate.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Settings button/password prompt, prefix fields, HTTP URL field (AGV control IP), OPC URL field (Hospital control IP), and Save Settings button.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Scanner setup steps 5-7: click settings button, enter password (default "Opti"); verify prefixes match tote/location labels; change URL for both the HTTP and OPC settings to contain the AGV control and Hospital control IP addresses respectively; save with "Save Settings".
